lines: Results now shows what the ride earned: XP, stars and your personal best.
XP earned shows the total, then every line in the order the backend returned it: finished, your place, the podium, time on target and your streak.
Stars on the map shows how many of three you hold, and plus one new star when the ride earned one. A class has no stars panel.
Beat your best time solo and it reads new personal best, with the best before. Slower, it reads you finished, with your best.
While the ride is recorded the panel says so. With no network, your XP is added when you're back online. A refused ride earns none.
On a phone the panels follow the standings. From a tablet in landscape, they sit beside them.
What the tests prove: the star rules case by case, the answer through the API, and every panel state.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
